one_line: Amazon targets Decart in a $7.5bn deal, while UBS projects AI spending will reach $1.4 trillion in 2027.

themes.title: Amazon pursues Decart amid rising infrastructure costs
themes.text: Amazon is in advanced talks to acquire AI startup Decart for about $7.5 billion. Meanwhile, UBS projects global AI investment will hit $1.4 trillion in 2027, and server suppliers are raising prices by up to 45% after contract signing.

stories.headline: Amazon close to $7.5bn acquisition of AI startup Decart
UBS projects global AI investment to reach USD 1.4 trillion in 2027
AI server suppliers demand higher prices after contracts signed

themes.title: Li Ming charged in chip smuggling case
themes.text: Singapore prosecutors charged Chinese national Li Ming with fraud regarding misleading statements about Nvidia-equipped servers. Investigations show Li was central to smuggling restricted AI chips from Southeast Asia to China.

stories.headline: Chinese national Li Ming charged in fraud case linked to Megaspeed
Li Ming central to smuggling restricted AI chips from Southeast Asia to China

themes.title: UN fails to regulate autonomous weapons
themes.text: UN diplomats in Geneva failed to establish legally binding rules for autonomous weapons during a weeklong conference. Major military powers, including the US, Russia, and Israel, obstructed stronger measures, pushing discussions out for two more years.

stories.headline: UN talks fail to produce binding rules for autonomous weapons
